user.title: Select dashboards
user.description: Choose which dashboards you want to filter. Save automatically generated dashboards before selecting them.

targets.title: Select accounts
targets.description: Choose Selected accounts or All accounts. Filtering applies only while these accounts view selected dashboards. Home Assistant permissions still apply.

cards.title: Add dashboard cards
cards.description: Choose either card, both, or leave both unchecked. Selected cards will be added to an administrator-only Loona dashboard. You can also add the bundled cards to your own dashboards later.

finish.title: Finish setup
finish.description: **Refresh your browser after finishing setup.** The new cards cannot be viewed until the browser loads the Loona card files.

error.no_accounts: Select at least one active account.
error.invalid_selection: Some choices are no longer available or were selected twice. Choose from the current list.

abort.already_configured: Only one Loona integration can be configured.

dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.description: Choose which dashboards you want to filter.

targets.title: Select accounts
targets.description: Choose Selected accounts or All accounts. Filtering applies only while these accounts view selected dashboards. Home Assistant permissions still apply.

filters.title: Filters and performance
filters.description: Enable or disable the features you need. Entity filtering is automatic. Registry filtering reduces entity and device details. Delay graph loading waits to load off-screen graphs; scrolling to them loads them immediately. Animation pausing resumes automatically. Resource filtering loads required files and your selections under Cards. Refresh the browser after resource changes. Delay card files loads this dashboard's modules first and the rest later. Reload after enabling.

rules.title: Entity rules
rules.description: Add entities Loona missed under Included. Include whole entity types or enter known entity IDs and domain rules such as sensor.*. Exclusions override inclusions. Person, update and zone entities used by the Home Assistant interface are always kept.

confirm_remove_dashboard.title: Remove the Loona dashboard
confirm_remove_dashboard.description: Remove the generated Loona dashboard and its cards? Edited dashboards are preserved. Cancel this flow to keep the current selection.
